name: Tuva (Tuvan SSR, 1990–1992)
description: A red field with a blue vertical stripe at the hoist, a yellow hammer and sickle beneath a yellow-bordered red star in the upper hoist, and the inscription 'Тувинская ССР / Тыва ССР' in Russian and Tuvan in yellow.
history: The RSFSR-pattern flag of the Tuvan ASSR with the inscription changed after the sovereignty declaration of December 1990. It was replaced on 17 September 1992 by the light blue flag with the yellow and white bands.

features.role: inscription 'Тувинская ССР / Тыва ССР' in Russian and Tuvan
